playable_skill_records.name: Headshot
playable_skill_records.description: Deal 150% ATK as piercing damage.

playable_skill_records.name: Smoke Bomb
playable_skill_records.description: Increases evasion by 15% for 2 turns.

playable_skill_records.name: Arc Tether
playable_skill_records.description: Lashes a high-voltage wire between target and ground, dealing lightning damage and applying Shock.

playable_skill_records.name: Cryo Vent
playable_skill_records.description: Purges pressurized coolant through the cutter shroud, freezing armor plates and applying Brittle for 2 turns. Physical attacks deal +50% damage to Brittle targets.

playable_skill_records.name: Plasma Burst
playable_skill_records.description: Overdrives the cutter nozzle to hose the enemy formation in superheated gas, triggering Meltdown.

playable_skill_records.name: Rend Round
playable_skill_records.description: A barbed flechette round calibrated to bite deep into armor seams. Deals massive bonus damage and Bleed against staggered targets.

playable_skill_records.name: Shatter Blow
playable_skill_records.description: A heavy pneumatic piston strike that fractures enemy armor and applies Weak.

playable_skill_records.name: Bulwark Stance
playable_skill_records.description: Plants magnetic boots and locks reinforced forearm plates into place, granting Guard and Braced.

playable_skill_records.name: Overload Fists
playable_skill_records.description: Shorts maintenance capacitors through his gauntlets, delivering a concussive jolt that shocks the target.

playable_skill_records.name: Quake Slam
playable_skill_records.description: Slams the deck with full pneumatic force, sending a shockwave across the enemy line that applies Weak, with devastating bonus damage against stunned targets.

playable_skill_records.name: Prism Lance
playable_skill_records.description: Channels coherent harmonic light through a focusing crystal, delivering an armor-piercing beam.

playable_skill_records.name: Nano Repair
playable_skill_records.description: Deploys an aerosol of medical nanites that knit flesh and seal torn suits over time.

playable_skill_records.name: Disruption Pulse
playable_skill_records.description: Emitters pulse an inverted resonance wave that scrambles targeting sensors and leaves all foes Weakened.

playable_skill_records.name: Stasis Field
playable_skill_records.description: Generates a localized cryogenic dampening sphere that flash-freezes the opposing vanguard.

playable_skill_records.name: Venom Edge
playable_skill_records.description: Coats a vibroblade in caustic slag runoff, carving open armor seams and leaving lingering Erosion.

playable_skill_records.name: System Crash
playable_skill_records.description: Injects an overload virus into target kinetic systems, shutting down their response loop with Stun.

playable_skill_records.name: Shadow Flurry
playable_skill_records.description: Steps through blind spots in a blur of blade strikes, leaving the entire enemy squad Bleeding.

playable_skill_records.name: Blast Wave
playable_skill_records.description: Unleashes a concussive pulse of raw Source kinetic energy, shattering Guard across all enemies and inflicting Stun.

playable_skill_records.name: Signal Jammer
playable_skill_records.description: Floods tactical frequencies with screeching white noise, silencing automated systems and confusing organic targets.

playable_skill_records.name: Hydraulic Kick
playable_skill_records.description: A reinforced work-boot strike powered by pressurized pneumatic servos. Shatters enemy Guard and leaves the target Weakened.

playable_skill_records.name: Pulse Grenade
playable_skill_records.description: Lobs a repurposed acoustic excavation charge into the enemy squad, dealing physical concussive damage and Staggering the formation.

playable_skill_records.name: Scrap Shot
playable_skill_records.description: Fires a rapid spray of jagged slag debris from the cutter muzzle. Fast and dependable, but lacks armor penetration.

playable_skill_records.name: Cheap Shot
playable_skill_records.description: Kicks up a blinding flurry of metal filings into the target's optics, lowering enemy accuracy and granting bonus Evasion.

playable_skill_records.name: Synergy Pitch
playable_skill_records.description: Hurls a deployable hard-light emitter, anchoring an auxiliary kinetic Barrier around a frontline ally.

playable_skill_records.name: Stasis Stitch
playable_skill_records.description: Directs a tether of repair nanites to stitch torn flesh and weave an emergency sub-dermal shield.

playable_skill_records.name: Target Lock
playable_skill_records.description: Paints the enemy's structural seams with a targeting laser, drastically boosting critical strike vulnerability while raising personal defenses.

playable_skill_records.name: Slide Kick
playable_skill_records.description: Drops low across the metal grating to sweep the target's legs or treads, shattering Guard and causing Stagger.

playable_skill_records.name: Intercept
playable_skill_records.description: Gh0st intercepts attacks targeting an ally, gaining Guard.

playable_skill_records.name: Scan
playable_skill_records.description: Use the Lens to reveal hidden routes and expose enemy harmonic weaknesses.

playable_skill_records.name: Phase Counter
playable_skill_records.description: Gh0st uses the override key discipline to counter an incoming strike and mark the attacker.

playable_skill_records.name: Construct
playable_skill_records.description: Use the Anvil to shape Source intent into a temporary barrier or strike.

playable_skill_records.name: Harden
playable_skill_records.description: Gh0st hardens his stance with Phantom combat data, gaining Guard and stability.

playable_skill_records.name: Corporate Insight
playable_skill_records.description: Dominion command patterns expose predictable weaknesses in corporate security units.

playable_skill_records.name: Sunbeam
playable_skill_records.description: Orion focuses stored solar energy into a burning Source beam.

playable_skill_records.name: Stasis
playable_skill_records.description: Use the Anchor to freeze a target in a fixed moment, stopping even self-repairing machines.

playable_skill_records.name: Data Shield
playable_skill_records.description: Purged defensive routines harden the party against signal disruption and Silence.

playable_skill_records.name: Legacy
playable_skill_records.description: Jed's memory steadies Nova's aim when the cost matters most.

playable_skill_records.name: Unshackled
playable_skill_records.description: Increases Zeke's Agility and action recovery speed.

playable_skill_records.name: Source Balance
playable_skill_records.description: A clean carrier signal grants Defense scaling against physical and Source pressure.

playable_skill_records.name: Ancestral Grace
playable_skill_records.description: The Aethel burial current continuously restores Orion while he remains in the fight.

playable_skill_records.name: Tune World
playable_skill_records.description: Open the Starborn circuit and rewrite one catastrophic resonance through collective intent.

playable_skill_records.name: Guardian Covenant
playable_skill_records.description: Apply Shield and Braced across the party through the recovered guardian bus.

playable_skill_records.name: Link
playable_skill_records.description: Restore party HP and apply Regen through the Bridge ground. Does not share damage.
